# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.9

Teaching owners can create physical classrooms and scheduled classes again. Attendance follows the teacher assignments effective on each lesson date. Retrying a previous request preserves a later attendance edit. Leave and closures temporarily change the displayed status while retaining the original entry.

Classes retain multi-lesson report progress, including makeup lessons. Teachers can add an eligible trial report by hand. Report reference and course copy default to the primary course and lesson, including makeup lessons. End-only progress stays in the end field. Class attendance copy uses the effective occurrence time and current roster. Classroom and account security now show translated inline messages.

GoTrue custom OIDC supports Authentik discovery and existing-account linking when configured for both services.

Back up the database and apply all pending migrations in order through `1000177_report_end_only_progress.sql`. Deploy the frontend, API and Presidio images tagged `2.0.0-alpha.9`. Follow the [OAuth deployment guide](../../docs/deployment/auth-oauth-mail.md) for provider settings, callbacks and manual linking.
